description: This is a Java unit test class for the RetrieveAclStrategy class, testing its immutability and behavior when retrieving access control lists (ACLs) in the context of Ditto's thing persistence. It uses JUnit for testing and static imports for constants and utility methods.

classes.name: RetrieveAclStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveAclStrategy, verifying immutability and correctness of ACL retrieval logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of RetrieveAclStrategy.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that RetrieveAclStrategy class instances are immutable.

methods.name: resultContainsJsonOfExistingAcl
methods.description: Tests that the result contains the JSON representation of an existing ACL.

methods.name: resultContainsEmptyJsonObject
methods.description: Tests that the result contains an empty JSON object when no ACL is present.
